HOW TO PLAY

🥊

BEST OF 3 ROUNDS

The first fighter to win 2 rounds claims victory as the Street Legend Champion. Each round has a 90-second time limit.

💥

ATTACK ARSENAL

Punch: 8 HP. Fast speed, close range.
Kick: 12 HP. Medium speed, longer reach.
Special Attack: 20 HP. Devastating energy projectile (5-second cooldown).

🛡️

DEFENSE & TACTICS

Hold Block to reduce incoming damage by 80%. You cannot attack while blocking. Fighters automatically face each other.

⏱️

ROUND RESOLUTION

Reduce the opponent's HP to 0 for a K.O.! If time expires, the fighter with the most remaining health wins the round. Equal health results in a Draw.
